changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla roles: catálogo de roles de la aplicación (learner, instructor, admin; sin rol evaluator, DEF-24). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría roles_audit y el trigger roles_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Application roles catalog (learner, instructor, admin). There is no evaluator role: evaluators are assigned per course in course_evaluators

column.name: code
column.remarks: Unique role code used in code and authorization (learner, instructor, admin)

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE roles ADD CONSTRAINT roles_code_ck CHECK (code IN ('learner', 'instructor', 'admin'))
CREATE TRIGGER roles_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in roles

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE roles_audit ADD CONSTRAINT roles_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER roles_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON roles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS roles_audit_trg ON roles
